verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a REST API for managing sites and DNS programmatically [netlify-docs-14] and supports custom domains with automatic HTTPS [netlify-docs-20, netlify-docs-9, netlify-comm-8], so programmatic domain provisioning is plausible. Nothing in the evidence describes routing many tenant-owned domains to one multi-tenant app. missing for 10: an explicit multi-tenant or SaaS custom-domain feature, documented API endpoints for adding and verifying customer domains, per-tenant routing, certificate provisioning at scale for customer domains, and independent hands-on corroboration.
